rows.title: Venerable Ephraim the Syrian
rows.modern:
You watered your bed with tears, as the prophet said,
and sought repentance through the lessons of life.
You showed us through your words the fear of judgment by deeds!
As we gather together in honor of your memory, all-blessed one,
we celebrate the most glorious deeds you did alone in the Lord,
ever-memorable Ephraim!//
Therefore we pray that you will intercede with Christ for our souls!

rows.title: Great Martyr Theodore the Tyro (Recruit)
rows.modern:
By prayer you armed yourself with the courage of a martyr,
athlete of Christ!
You allied yourself mystically with His power,
struggling to offer rational sacrifice to God.
You laid low the godlessness of idolatry and the threats of torturers,
despising tortures and the passing fire.
How great the gifts of God in both reality and name!//
By your prayers, save those who celebrate your memory from all misfortune!

rejected_roundtrip.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great
rejected_roundtrip.modern:
You excelled in your life, Father Euthymius,
and your faith was truly Orthodox.
Through activity you reached the highest vision
and became a dwelling of wisdom.
You worshipped Christ in two natures as one of the Trinity.//
Pray to Him on our behalf!

rejected_roundtrip.title: Venerable Hilarion the Great
rejected_roundtrip.modern:
You were meek of soul and heart,
wounded by divine love!
You withdrew from the turmoils of life by a holy ascent.
Armed with the weapon of the Cross
you advanced on the demons and waged war, most blessed one!
You wrought a crown of victory for yourself
and now you dwell in the splendor of the saints!
Together with them, ask for deliverance of sins for us,//
peace and enlightenment!

rejected_roundtrip.title: Saint Averkios the Wonderworker, Bishop
rejected_roundtrip.label: To Abercius
rejected_roundtrip.modern:
You wrought a miracle, Father,
mingling wine and oil in a single vessel, preserving them in that way,
but when needed you caused them to separate by divine grace!
By your supplication you caused a gift of warm water to gush forth
healing the infirmities of those who approach you with faith//
and call you blessed, Father Abercius!
